question: What is the percentage of carbon in double-bond molecules?
evidence: carbon refers to element = 'c'; double-bond molecules refers to bond_type = '='; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(element = 'c'), COUNT(atom_id))
clarification: Count every row, including repeated atom_id values.
gold: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '='
gold0: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '='

d.request: What is the percentage of carbon atoms among double-bond molecules (bond_type = '='), calculated as the sum of rows where element = 'c' divided by the total count of atom_id, with every row counted, including repeated atom_id values?
d.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage FROM atom a INNER JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '='

b.request: What percentage of all atom rows (counting every row from joining atoms to bonds, including repeated atom_id values) in molecules with a double bond (bond_type = '=') have element = 'c'?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM atom a JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '='
